A Choose and circle. Use the distance clues.

Your bag is next to you: this / that bag.
Two keys are next to you: these / those keys.
A notebook is across the room: this / that notebook.
Two phones are across the room: these / those phones.

B Complete the messages with this is, that is, these are or those are.

Near me, one phone:  my phone.
Far from me, two bags:  your bags.
Near me, two keys:  my keys.
One item, then the same item
2B
First mention

I have a bag.
I have an umbrella.

→
We know which one

The bag is red.
The umbrella is black.

C Complete with a, an or the.

I have  notebook and  umbrella.  notebook is blue.  umbrella is black.

D Find and correct the two mistakes.

I have an phone. A phone is in my bag.

Grammar practice · Unit 3

Routines: statements and questions
Present simple: routines
3A
he / she / it

work → works

watch → watches

go → goes

have → has

A Choose and circle.

My brother work / works at a hotel.
We have / has breakfast at eight.
Emma go / goes to work by bus.
I watch / watches TV after dinner.

B Change the sentences from I to she.

I get up at six. → She .
I have lunch at one. → She .
I go home at five. → She .
Do you? Does she?
3B
Present simple
Form	I / you / we / they	he / she / it
Positive	You work.	He works.
Negative	You do not work.	He does not work.
Yes/no question	Do you work?	Does he work?
Short answer	Yes, I do. / No, I don’t.	Yes, he does. / No, he doesn’t.

do not = don’t · does not = doesn’t

do / does / don’t / doesn’t → work ✓ works ✗

Compare

He is here. → Is he here?

He works here. → Does he work here?

C Make these statements negative.

We work on Saturday. → We .
Leo eats breakfast at home. → Leo .

D Write questions. Then complete the short answers.

Mia / live near the café? 
Yes, she .
you / walk to work? 
No, I .

Details, frequency and order
Ask for the missing detail
3C

Where → a place
Where do you go? To the park.

Who → a person
Who do you go with? My friend.

When → a day or time
When do you go? On Friday.

What time → a clock time
What time do you go? At six.

A Complete with where, what time or who.

 do you work? At Green Café.
 does Ana have lunch? At twelve.
 do you go with? My sister.

B Put the words in order.

on Saturday / where / go / do / you / ?

How often? Where in the sentence?
3D
always
● ● ● ●
usually
● ● ● ○
sometimes
● ○ ○ ○
never
○ ○ ○ ○

I usually walk to work.

be
I am usually at home at six.

C Choose the correct position.

I always drink / drink always water.
She usually is / is usually at home.
We never watch / watch never TV at breakfast.

D Write a true sentence with sometimes and a true sentence with am usually.

Put the day in order
3D
07:00
breakfast
→

walk to work

I have breakfast before I walk to work.

I walk to work after breakfast.

E Use the times above. Choose and circle.

I walk to work before / after breakfast.
I have breakfast before / after I walk to work.

F Write two things you do in order. Join them with before or after.

Enough for everyone
More, enough or less than we need
4C
Need: two tomatoes

● ● ● ● ● ●

too many tomatoes
Need: two tomatoes

● ●

enough tomatoes
Need: two tomatoes

●

not enough tomatoes

Countable plural: too many tomatoes

Uncountable: too much oil

cheese enough → enough cheese

tomatoes not enough → not enough tomatoes

A Choose and circle.

We need two eggs. We have six: too many / not enough eggs.
We need milk. There is no milk: enough / not enough milk.
One spoon of oil is good. Ten spoons is too much / too many oil.

B Put the words in order.

we / rice / enough / have → 
tomatoes / do / not / enough / have / we → 
Give a reason; show a result
4D
Reason

I have too much bread.

→
Result

I share it.

Result ← because ← reason

I share it because I have too much bread.

Reason → , so → result

I have too much bread, so I share it.

C Choose and circle.

I share the apples because / so I have too many.
The soup is very salty, because / so I don’t like it.

D Rewrite with capital letters, a comma, a full stop and a question mark.

i have too many eggs so i share them do you want two

E Write a short food-sharing message. Say what you have and why you are sharing it.
